$GFS GlobalFoundries $GFS signed a letter of intent for a $300 million CHIPS R&D award to advance U.S.-based silicon photonics for AI infrastructure.

The Details:

•	Research focus: Funding targets optical materials, wafer technology, and advanced packaging for near- and co-packaged optics.

•	Platform goal: GF’s SCALE platform targets 400 Gb/s performance and 5x greater energy efficiency.

•	U.S. footprint: R&D and manufacturing will use GlobalFoundries facilities in New York and Vermont.

•	Industry backing: AMD, Nvidia, Microsoft, Meta, and Broadcom support the initiative. Commerce would receive about 1% equity in GF.

Red Cat $RCAT validated partner technologies on its Black Widow and Teal 2 drones through its SPiDRWORX innovation program.

The Details:

•	Communications range: Hoverfly extended Black Widow’s communications range using a tethered unmanned aircraft system.

•	Autonomous operations: Palantir tested vision-based navigation for GPS-denied settings, while Vigilare AI validated voice-controlled Teal 2 operations.

•	AI and mapping: Safe Pro Group demonstrated AI threat detection from drone imagery. Reveal Technology expanded 3D mapping and photogrammetry testing.

JPMorgan sees hawkish Fed hold as base case: $JPM



JPMorgan $JPM expects the Fed to hold rates, with a hawkish message most likely and limited near-term impact on the S&P 500.

The Details:

•	Base case: A hawkish hold has a 50% probability; JPMorgan sees the S&P 500 roughly flat to down 0.5%.

•	Bull case: A dovish hold has a 28% probability and could lift the S&P 500 by up to 1%.

•	Bear case: A 25-basis-point hike has a 20% probability and could drop the S&P 500 by 1.5%–2%.

•	Tech risk: JPMorgan expects the Nasdaq to underperform if the Fed raises rates.
